exposure: fetal head station at the index cesarean delivery
cohort: 481 primiparous women with prior cesarean delivery for second-stage dystocia
finding: Lower fetal head station at the index cesarean delivery for second-stage dystocia was independently associated with a higher vaginal birth after cesarean rate.
mod_finding: Lower fetal head station at the index cesarean delivery for second-stage dystocia was independently associated with a higher vaginal birth after cesarean rate.
